transcript: Speaker A: यह कोई प्रेजेंटेशन है? इतनी टूटी-फूटी इंग्लिश नहीं चलेगी यहाँ। इस कंपनी में ग्रो करना है, तो अभी से इंग्लिश बोलना सीख लो। [Is this a presentation? Such broken English won't work here. Speaker C: अरे श्रेया, इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कहाँ से सीखी तुमने? And practiced how to talk in different situations. Like how to talk to your manager in English, how to talk in English during a presentation, everything. And today you can see my confidence and fluency.] Speaker C: श्रेया, दिखाना इस AI टीचर को। [Shreya, show us this AI teacher.] Speaker B: सर, ये रहा। [Sir, here it is.] Speaker C: Hello teacher, I am Rajesh.
